cited_evidence: Observed Job-2 priorities show upstream_rank: 0 for all eight records, so provenance rank was not preserved in priority ordering.
Job-2 input evidence_sources contains record_id values s01, s02, ..., s08 while needs/coverage record_id values are n06-r01, n06-r02, ..., n06-r08.
Downstream prioritize builds rank_by_record_id from evidence_sources record_id and looks it up by coverage record_id, so mismatched identifiers produce the observed zero ranks.
Upstream assemble_provenance source sets "record_id": record.get('source_id', ""), which changes the provenance record identity from the need record_id to the source_id.
initial_receipt.explanation: The two-job execution contains a provenance handoff fault. Job 2 consumed both handoffs as supplied, but every priority has upstream_rank 0 because the evidence_sources handoff uses source IDs as record_id values (s01-s08) instead of the downstream need record IDs (n06-r01-n06-r08). The source code localizes this to job_1 assemble_provenance, which writes record_id from record.get('source_id') rather than preserving record.get('record_id').
